title: Tooling: bd auto-export leaves .beads/issues.jsonl staged after merges, which blocks 'git pull --rebase' on main (hit at M3 and M5 start). Commit the export with the merge, or have bd stop staging it.

M2: hold -> capture/expire via signals and timers; idempotent activities

M1: Temporal Go SDK + authorization workflow skeleton tested with SDK testsuite; in-memory ledger with balance invariant test
